mapper.select: SELECT c.ID id, MIN(i.ALARM_LEVEL) alarmLevel FROM CABINET c LEFT JOIN ROOM r ON c.ROOM_ID = r.ID LEFT JOIN ASSET_ATTACH a ON a.CABINET_ID = c.ID LEFT JOIN ALARM_INFO i ON a.ASSET_ID = i.ASSET_ID WHERE (i.STATUS = 1 OR (i.STATUS = 2 AND i.ALARM_STATE = 1)) AND i.BLANK = 1 AND r.ORG_ID = #{orgId} GROUP BY c.ID

select x.*, y.alarm_level from (select a.id assetId, a.name assetName, a.asset_image, a.asset_mode, a.ip, a.ip2, a.watch, h.end_position, h.start_position, c.name cabinetName from asset a left join asset_attach h on a.id = h.asset_id left join cabinet c on h.cabinet_id = c.id where a.is_del = 1 and a.desk != 1831 and a.id in (select asset_id from asset_attach where cabinet_id = #{id})) x left join (select asset_id, min(alarm_level) alarm_level from alarm_info i where i.blank = 1 and (i.STATUS = 1 OR i.ALARM_STATE = 1) and i.asset_id in (select asset_id from asset_attach where cabinet_id = #{id}) group by asset_id) y on x.assetId = y.asset_id

select i.id, i.title, i.alarm_level, i.content, i.occur_time, i.type, i.status, i.blank, i.IS_SHOW_RECOVER as isShowRecover, i.alarm_state from alarm_info i where i.blank = 1 and (i.status = 1 or (i.status = 2 and i.alarm_state = 1)) and i.asset_id in (select asset_id from asset_attach where cabinet_id = #{id}) order by i.occur_time desc
select * from cabinet where room_id = #{roomId} order by code asc
select c.* from cabinet c left join room r on c.room_id = r.id where r.org_id = #{orgId} order by c.row_index, c.column_index
select c.*, r.name as roomName from cabinet c left join room r on c.room_id = r.id where r.org_id = #{orgId} order by c.column_index
select c.* from cabinet c where c.id = ( select t.CABINET_ID from ASSET_ATTACH t where t.ASSET_ID = #{assetId} )
select c.* from cabinet c join room r on c.room_id = r.id where r.org_id = #{orgId} order by c.column_index

select t.id itemId, t.name itemName, '96' itemType, f.view_url viewUrl from asset t left join asset_attach a on t.id = a.asset_id left join file_relate f on t.id = f.item_id where a.cabinet_id = #{cabinetId} and t.is_del = 1 order by t.name
